name: Mountain Pose
description: Stand tall with feet together, arms at sides. Ground through feet, lengthen spine.

name: Downward Facing Dog
description: From hands and knees, lift hips up and back. Press heels toward floor.

name: Warrior I
description: Step one foot back, bend front knee, raise arms overhead. Square hips forward.

name: Warrior II
description: From Warrior I, open hips to side, arms parallel to floor, gaze over front hand.

name: Tree Pose
description: Balance on one foot, place other foot on inner thigh or calf. Hands at heart or overhead.

name: Triangle Pose
description: Wide stance, reach front hand down to shin/ankle, other arm up. Open chest.

name: Child's Pose
description: Kneel, sit back on heels, fold forward, arms extended or by sides. Rest forehead on mat.

name: Cat-Cow
description: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding spine with breath.

name: Cobra Pose
description: Lie on belly, hands under shoulders, press up lifting chest. Keep elbows bent.

name: Bridge Pose
description: Lie on back, knees bent, feet hip-width. Lift hips, clasp hands under back.

name: Seated Forward Fold
description: Sit with legs extended, hinge at hips, reach for feet. Keep spine long.

name: Corpse Pose
description: Lie flat on back, arms at sides, palms up. Complete relaxation.

name: Hiperflexion for Each Leg
description: Lie on back, extend one leg up while keeping the other flat. Hold the foot or use a strap. Switch legs.

name: Greatest Stretch for Side
description: From a lunge position, twist torso toward the front leg, reaching one arm up and the other down. Opens hips and side body.

name: Plunge for Hamstring for Side
description: Low lunge with back knee down, shift hips back to straighten front leg. Folds over the front leg to stretch the hamstring.

name: Quad Stretch
description: From a low lunge, lower the back knee and reach back to grab the back foot. Pull heel toward glute to stretch the quadriceps.
